title: Chapter 511
text:
This was a land with an extremely high concentration of nuclear radiation. The environment was desolate, and every inch of space was filled with a thick layer of gray. The blue sky was covered with a layer of darkness, and the ground was covered with a thick layer of white dust. There was not a single bit of green in sight, and there was no sign of life.

At this time, dozens of thin spaceships were parked there, and a group of mixed blood Godora people wearing galactic combat suits were fiddling with some strange equipment.

This vanguard was made up of ordinary Dark-star soldiers, and only the leader was a grade B. Their mission was to hide, and they did not need to engage in combat. These spaceships were always in stealth mode, blocking all kinds of detection equipment. Han Xiao's fleet had scouted the entire planet but was unable to find this small team. Dark-star had spent most of their skill points on stealth technology, or else they would have been killed long ago.

Dark-star had placed small teams in all the planets where the Mutation Source was placed, and their mission was to observe the situation at close range. Through special equipment, they would be able to detect the radiation emitted by the Mutation Source and understand the growth stage of the Mutation Source. This set of equipment was given to them by the manufacturer of the Mutation Source, and they were truly a kind intergalactic arms dealer.

However, this small team did not know the exact location of the Mutation Source, and they did not have any intention of searching for it. The orders from the higher-ups were not to interfere.

In truth, this small team of Dark-star had already been hiding in Blue Star since a month ago and had not revealed themselves. Through the more advanced virtual technology, they had connected to the satellites of the Six Nations and shared the vision of these 'eyes'. The destruction of this planet by the Mutation Disaster was seen by them, but they were not concerned about it. It was only until the appearance of Black Star that this small team started to pay attention and sent the news to the headquarters.

The upper echelons of Dark-star were paying attention to the progress of the plan. Black Star had once caused them to lose an elder, and he was already an enemy in their eyes. This news surprised the upper echelons, but after a round of discussion, they all felt that the reason Black Star had appeared in Blue Star was not because of them.

"We've investigated it. Blue Star is Black Star's hometown, and we happened to choose this planet. It should be that the natives of Blue Star have a way to contact Black Star. After the disaster happened, they asked for help from Black Star, which is why the current situation happened. The reason for Black Star's arrival has nothing to do with us. This is a coincidence."

"Indeed, that's the most logical explanation. We're hiding in the dark, so no one will know that these disasters are part of our plan."

"Godora's people will soon head to these planets for disaster relief. One more Black Star is just one more rescue team. Blue Star is just one of the planets and will not affect our plan."

Although they viewed Han Xiao as an enemy, they did not want to alert the enemy at such a crucial moment. Furthermore, after their investigation, they found out that Black Star actually had a tycoon-grade Blacklight Stealth and could escape as he wished. Thus, Dark-star gave up on the idea of attacking him.

In their eyes, Han Xiao's appearance was just a coincidence and would not affect the overall situation much. There was no need for them to be too nervous. At this moment, they had to prioritize the mission and not expose themselves.

The Mutation Disaster was the core of Dark-star's plan, but the most important thing was their following actions. They had to wait for the right opportunity.

…

In the next few days, the news about the Garton Star System became more and more intense. The advanced civilizations of the other Star Systems all watched on, but no one wanted to help. Those unlucky planets were under Godora's jurisdiction, and according to the rules of civilization diplomacy, they should be handled by Godora.

If the other advanced civilizations did not interfere, no one would blame them. However, if Godora did not help their allies in their jurisdiction, it would be a huge blow.

Of course, the disaster relief was not forced, but this would affect Godora's reputation and position in the Shattered Star Ring. The other allied civilizations would reevaluate their relationship with them. As a member of the lawful faction, they still had to follow certain rules. In order to stabilize their ruling position in the Garton Star System and calm the public opinion, Godora would naturally not sit by and do nothing.

Spaceships departed from the various military space stations of Godora one after another, heading to different Star Zones to provide disaster relief. The Six Nations, who had been waiting anxiously, finally received the news that the fleet was about to arrive at Blue Star.

The upper echelons of the Six Nations were almost moved to tears. After more than a month, Godora had finally remembered that it was the father. It was finally coming.

With Blue Star's technology, they were unable to find the source of the Mutation Disaster, but they believed that Godora would definitely be able to. With Godora's help, the disaster should be resolved very quickly.

While the Six Nations had given in to Han Xiao, the position that Godora had established over a long period of time would not be weakened so easily. What Black Star had promised them was the future, but there was no way to resolve the root of the calamity at the moment. Thus, when it came to dealing with the Mutation Disaster, the Six Nations still trusted Godora more.

On the day that Godora informed them of the arrival date, the leaders of the Six Nations brought some of their high-ranking officials to wait at the landing point. They provided the landing coordinates for Godora.

"This is the first time that the Godora Civilization has come on a large scale. We have to welcome them with the highest level of etiquette."

Meeting Godora's fleet was a huge matter for the entire civilization. Even though the Six Nations were in a difficult situation and had only managed to restore some order with the help of Han Xiao, the Six Nations did not dare to treat their savior carelessly and still prepared a welcoming ceremony.

However, the upper echelons of the Six Nations were also very nervous. This was the first time that they had seen an alien fleet, and they were not clear about Godora's culture or the situation in the universe. They were afraid that they would do something that would cause a misunderstanding.

On this day, the astronomical organizations of the Six Nations paid close attention to the sky. Their mission was to find traces of Godora's fleet as soon as possible.

The afternoon sun was at its brightest, and a fleet coincidentally entered Blue Star's atmosphere. A golden spaceship appeared from the clouds and slowly flew above Blue Star. This image was immediately obtained by the Six Nations.

The leaders of the Six Nations were all on high alert and prepared to welcome Godora at the landing point.

At this moment, the observer reported, "No, Godora has changed their route. They are not here!"

"What?"

The officials at the landing point were all shocked and hurriedly shared the image with them. They saw that Godora's fleet did not land at the designated location but changed their route midway and headed toward the Sanctuary.

The leaders of the Six Nations were all shocked.

The interaction between civilizations should be led by the Six Nations. Furthermore, they were the ones who requested for help. However, Godora had ignored them and ran over to Black Star.

They were the true rulers of this planet!

They had wanted to personally meet Godora and display the etiquette of the Blue Star civilization, but the actual situation was completely different from what they had imagined. The welcoming ceremony that they had painstakingly prepared was wasted, and the upper echelons of the Six Nations could not help but feel depressed. At the same time, they had a thought.

Could it be that to Godora, the entire Blue Star civilization was not as important as a single Black Star?

The leaders of the Six Nations felt a sense of humiliation and could not help but think of what Han Xiao had said. If they wanted to have a conversation as equals, they had to at least jump out of the level of the natives.

…

The golden fleet floated outside the Sanctuary, and the players ran out to take a look.

Bennett knew that the Six Nations had requested help from Godora, but he did not expect the fleet to come to him. He hurriedly went out to welcome them.

Buzz!

The bottom of all the spaceships opened up, and yellow gravitational beams shot out, pulling out Godora people one by one. It was like laying eggs.

The rescue team slowly landed, and the commander at the front was Nagojin.

Outside the walls of the Sanctuary, there were many new residential areas. When the guards and refugees saw this scene, their mouths were wide open, and their faces were blank. This was the first time they had seen Godora people, and they were both shocked and nervous. They stared at these aliens without blinking.

Bennett had seen the Godora people that Han Xiao had captured before. At this moment, he calmed himself down and walked forward to welcome them.

"Respected friends of Godora, I am Bennett, and I am currently in charge of this Sanctuary. On behalf of Blue Star, I welcome all of you here. Thank you for your generous help. This planet needs your help."

Nagojin did not deny it and pointed at the spaceships above the Sanctuary. He spoke through the translator with a solemn and dignified expression. "What's up with those spaceships?"

Blue Star was just a native planet, and the Godora soldiers present all had a sense of superiority on their faces. They did not place the natives in their eyes, but there was an interstellar fleet here, and they could not help but feel curious.

The reason Godora's fleet had come to the Sanctuary was not because they knew that Han Xiao was there but because they had discovered Han Xiao's fleet. As such, Nagojin changed the route of the fleet and did not land at the coordinates provided by the Six Nations. Instead, they came here to investigate.

Nagojin had the strength of a Calamity Grade Super, and the aura that he unconsciously exuded made Bennett's heart tighten. He subconsciously felt a sense of danger and forgot to speak.

At this moment, Han Xiao walked out from the crowd and chuckled. "Nagojin, we meet again."

"It's you!" Nagojin's eyes widened, and the solemn expression on his face disappeared. He laughed out loud and quickly walked forward to give Han Xiao a warm hug.

The last time they had fought side by side, he had left a deep impression on Nagojin, and he could not forget Han Xiao. At this moment, he recognized him at a glance.

"Black Star? Hahaha, I didn't expect you to be here too! "

Compared to his condescending attitude toward the natives of Blue Star, Nagojin's attitude toward Han Xiao was completely different. He hugged and patted Han Xiao's shoulder as though he was an old friend. It was a complete difference in treatment.

Hearing this, the troops behind Nagojin were in an uproar.

"It's actually Black Star!"

"That mercenary who killed a Dark-star Calamity Grade Super alongside Nagojin!"

The arrogance on the faces of the people of Godora was replaced by shock.

Looking at the two of them, Bennett was shocked and said in disbelief, "You … you know each other?"

"Didn't I tell you before? I have many friends in the galaxy." Han Xiao let go of Nagojin and said with a smile.

Bennett nodded. He had indeed heard Han Xiao mention it before, but he did not know the details. Seeing Han Xiao and the commander of the Godora fleet calling each other brothers, he finally had a direct understanding of Han Xiao's position in the galaxy.

"You're probably doing better than I thought." Bennett sighed with mixed feelings.

Not too long ago, Han Xiao had also sent him an invitation, and he had chosen to stay in Blue Star. Now, the gap between them had become so huge. He had even been frightened by the aura of this commander of Godora, but the other party was extremely friendly toward Han Xiao …

Bennett was only disappointed for a moment before he recovered and was secretly happy for Han Xiao.

In the distance, the players were whispering.

"I didn't expect Godora to come to our planet."

"The officer on the other side seems to be an acquaintance of the captain."

"I remember in Pork Bun's video that the captain has a good relationship with Godora. He should be the one who called the Godora people over for help."

"Amazing, the captain is really impressive."

"Ignorant. Do you think the Black Star Contacts Group is called for nothing?"

Ever since Han Xiao had started to recruit players, the way he was addressed by the players had gradually changed. He was no longer called Black Star but Captain. Even the players who had not joined the mercenary group liked to call him that. This made the players feel closer to him. Not long after, this name became popular on the forums, and 'Captain' became his new nickname.

Because Pork Bun's video had recorded many of the deeds of the Black Star Mercenary, the players knew that Han Xiao not only had the background of Floating Dragon, but he also had a good relationship with the various large mercenary groups. Furthermore, he had a good relationship with many civilizations of Order. Some people jokingly called it the 'Black Star Contacts Group'. Many people found it funny, and those who had watched the video resonated with it. Thus, it quickly became a meme.

The information of the players was limited, and they did not know that the Mutation Disaster was caused by the battle between Godora and Dark-star. They also did not know that the Six Nations had asked Godora for help. Thus, at this time, the players still thought that the Godora fleet was summoned by Han Xiao.

As expected of the Black Star Contacts Group.

Nagojin was happy for a while before remembering his duty. He asked, "By the way, why are you here?"
